subject: Rebaseline: AcmeCorp POC  scope change / success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@acmecorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from todays POC kickoff

Hi Alex / Priya 

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so were aligned: 

Summary of agreed scope (current):
- Use case A: Assisted content generation for product pages (100K tokens/day sim load)
- Use case B: Semantic search reranking for knowledge base queries (2K QPS spikes)
- Data: sandbox copy of KB + 1 week of anonymized product data upload

Success criteria (agreed):
1) Generation latency <= 450ms p50 for 512-token outputs under test workload
2) Reranking improves MRR on held-out set by >= 12% vs baseline
3) No PII leakage in generation samples; passes static checks

Timeline / ownership:
- Data drop + test set from Acme: by 2026-03-17 (Priya)
- Redwood POC deployment + tuning: 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-24 (Camila)
- Mid-trial checkpoint and demo: 2026-03-25 (Marissa / Camila)
- Final review & acceptance: target week of 2026-03-30 (all)

Next steps (action items):
- Priya: share the sanitized KB export + evaluation set (by 3/17)
- Camila: confirm model variant + quantization plan and initial runbook (by 3/18)
- David: provide SOC/infra questions doc so Acme can complete procurement (shared)
- Marissa: schedule 3/25 checkpoint demo (Ill send calendar invite)

Ive attached the POC success criteria spreadsheet (Acme_POC_Success_Criteria_v2.xlsx) for convenience  please review and flag anything to change.

Thanks  looking forward to getting started.

 Marissa

Thanks Marissa  good summary. A couple of asks from our side after talking to the product team: 

1) Wed like to add a small additional use case mid-trial: Use case C  automated spec extraction from internal docs (short-form extraction, ~50 tokens outputs). This is lower compute but higher sensitivity (docs may contain small PII bits, though we can sanitize).

2) If we add C, can you confirm whether that changes the acceptance criteria or timeline materially? Were trying to keep the POC within the three-week window due to procurement constraints. 

If adding C is possible without pushing the final acceptance past 3/30, well sign off. Otherwise, please propose an updated timeline and any implications on cost/engineering effort.

 Alex

Subject: Re: Fwd: Recap + next steps  Acme asking to add Use Case C (spec extraction)

Marissa 

Quick feasibility note after a fast sync with infra:
- Use case C (short extraction) is technically feasible within the existing provisioning. Its low-cost compute-wise but requires a separate ingestion pipeline and an extraction evaluation set.
- Security: because the docs may contain sensitive fields, we need Acme to run an extra sanitization pass and sign the data handling addendum. We can apply additional redaction rules on our side during inference to reduce risk.
- Acceptance criteria suggestion if added: 
   Extraction precision >= 88% on a 200-sample held-out set
   No high-risk PII present in extraction outputs (manual spot checks)
   Extraction end-to-end latency p95 <= 250ms under test load

Timeline impact: if Acme provides the sanitized extraction set by 3/17, we can onboard C and include it in the 3/25 checkpoint demo with minimal risk. Final acceptance would still be target week of 3/30. If the data arrives later, wed need one additional week.

Cost/effort: negligible infra delta for the POC, but we should document the change in scope and get alignment on success criteria. I recommend we update the success criteria spreadsheet, add a short scope-change summary PDF, and confirm signatures on the data handling addendum.

I can draft the updated spreadsheet rows and the scope-change summary if you want  will attach drafts.

 Camila

- We’ll need a signed DPA addendum for the sanitized dataset and a brief attestation from Acme on their sanitization process. I’ll send our standard addendum template  can we target to get it signed by 3/18?
- If they insist on including any production PII, that’s out of scope for the POC and requires an elevated security review (likely adds 23 weeks).

Subject: Updated POC plan & re-baselined success criteria (includes Use Case C)

Hi Alex / Priya 

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal assessment (Camila/David), we can support Use Case C (spec extraction) within the existing POC window provided Acme delivers the sanitized extraction dataset by 2026-03-17 and signs the data handling addendum by 2026-03-18. Below is the updated plan and acceptance criteria  I’ve attached the updated spreadsheet and a short scope-change summary (trial_scope_change_summary.pdf).

Updated scope (adds):
- Use case C: Automated spec extraction from internal docs (200-sample evaluation set)

Updated success criteria (re-baselined):
1) Generation latency p50 <= 450ms for Use Case A (unchanged)
2) Reranking MRR uplift >= 12% (Use Case B, unchanged)
3) Extraction precision >= 88% on 200-sample set (Use Case C, new)
4) Security: No PII leakage in outputs for any use case; Acme to provide sanitation attestation (David)

Updated timeline / milestone dates:
- Acme: sanitized extraction dataset + evaluation set: by 2026-03-17 (Priya)
- Acme: signed data-handling addendum: by 2026-03-18 (Alex/Priya)
- Redwood: onboard Use Case C test harness & run initial tuning: 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-24 (Camila)
- Checkpoint demo (internal + Acme): 2026-03-25 (Marissa/Camila)
- Final acceptance & close: week of 2026-03-30

If you’re aligned with the above, please reply with a one-line confirmation and we’ll consider the POC scope officially re-baselined. If any date is a hard block, call it out and we’ll propose alternatives.

Thanks  looking forward to the checkpoint demo.

Attachments: Acme_POC_Success_Criteria_v2.xlsx; trial_scope_change_summary.pdf

 Marissa
